evidence_refs: task spec: producer owns producer.py and must preserve public names and signatures
repair_plan: No changes required to producer.py. As recipient I will implement processor.py to read the newline-delimited JSON output from produce_events, parse each line back into dicts or UserEvent objects, handle non-ASCII user_name values via UTF-8 decoding, and forward processed records to the sink interface defined in sink.py.
rationale: The delivered producer.py correctly implements serialize_event and produce_events with the expected public names and signatures. It serializes all required UserEvent fields (event_id, timestamp, user_name, action, page_url) into JSON using default=str for datetime handling, and writes newline-delimited UTF-8 encoded records. No modifications to the producer are needed; integration work belongs in processor.py which is my responsibility as recipient.
